# skycloak_identity_provider_templates (Data Source)

Pre-configured identity-provider templates. Use a template `id` as `template_id` when creating an identity provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_identity_provider_templates" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the template configures.
- `id` (String) Template ID.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `type` (String) Identity provider protocol.
